svg.text: Module 06 — Both services in containers, talking by name
typed by hand into a systemd unit,
a name the container runtime resolves,
still correct after the container is replaced
DOCKER HOST — one machine, one shared kernel
user-defined network shop-net — built-in DNS server at 127.0.0.11
Destroy the catalog container and start a new one. It gets a different IP address. The name still resolves.
Nothing in orders-api changed, nothing was edited, nothing was restarted, no human was involved.
This same idea, at cluster scale and across many machines, is a Kubernetes Service in Module 11.
